items.title: Sol Yaged interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000
items.q: That’s where I saw Benny Goodman for the first time, coming out of the stage door, in I think it was 1937. I couldn’t believe how tall he was.

ctx.x: That’s great. When you were 13 years old — I don’t know why I picked 13 — did you have aspirations to be a full time musician at that age?
Well when I heard Benny Goodman on the radio, I was about 13 years old then you’re right — what made you pick that year out?
